title: Grasshopper 744m Test | Single Camera (Hexacopter)
summary: SpaceX footage of the Grasshopper vehicle's 744 m test hop, filmed from a hexacopter that gets closer than earlier flights. Grasshopper was a vertical takeoff and landing rig built to test returning rockets to the pad.
why: Used as the go-to clip showing SpaceX's reusable-rocket landing tests, often in comparisons with other vertical landing programs.

quote.text: the spacex grasshopper test was the first that I saw that had the rocket do a vertical takeoff, and then land.
